caption: The drawing depicts a detailed illustration of a decorative metal andiron in perspective view, showing intricate craftsmanship. The object is comprised of a tall, central turned post with a multi-tiered finial at the top, supported by three curving legs terminating in small rounded feet. The andiron’s horizontal member, on which items might rest, features a decorative pierced panel with symmetrical scrolling patterns and foliage elements. The colors used are primarily shades of gold and brass, highlighted with darker outlines and shadowing to suggest metallic surfaces. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller elevation view of the andiron rendered in gray pencil with an adjacent scale in inches beneath it. The drawing is signed "JAMES O'MARA" in the bottom right corner, and is bordered by a single-line rectangular frame. The background is an off-white color with some visible aging marks around the edges.
title: Andirons
